title: Ten 2026 predictions on which to hold me accountable (fixture)
body_html:
I've got a prediction. I've got a pretty good track record of predictions! Here are ten for 2026 (fixture copy).

• The first ERISA lawsuit referencing mental health parity violations will be filed. I have been arguing that this is a good case to bring. It happens in 2026.

• There will be three or more at-home depression treatment devices on the market by the end of 2026. We already have the Flow approval announced, and more is coming.

• COMP360 and KetaFree (IV Ketamine) will be approved for MDD by FDA.

• Fixture paraphrase: Radial will open three more clinics in 2026.
